title: DFA extends 14-day visa-free entry for Chinese tourists, business visitors
summary: The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) said Monday it extended for another year a policy allowing Chinese tourists and business visitors to enter the Philippines visa-free and stay for up to 14 days.
